dct_description_sm:
This record is for the dataset “Understory micrometeorological data across a larch forest density gradient” at https://doi.org/10.18739/A2CD3V.

This data set contains half-hourly observations of understory radiation, air temperature, relative humidity, and soil moisture and temperature at two depths. Data are collected in six larch stands in northeastern Siberia: two each of high, medium, and low tree density. The accompanying density data can be found at https://www.aoncadis.org/dataset/Stand_Inventory.html

This data can be downloaded at https://doi.org/10.18739/A2CD3V.
dct_title_s: Understory micrometeorological data across a larch forest density gradient
